_comment: GAP-14 (b3d7f942 phase-6): Audit of 14 regenerated baseline screenshots.

baselines.regen_justification:
Pipeline f2a8c3e1 phase-5 live sweep re-captured canvas baseline after pywinauto test improvements; 10-byte size increase originally claimed to be PNG metadata-only.

Pipeline 3e7c1a05 phase-3 MD5 verification (commit <<PHASE-3-COMMIT>>) shows pixel content is NOT identical to the pre-regen baseline: before=22791dac434c920484bd9ead903ccf39, after=9ebb83f12224f29c346a0b260f06acd9, pixel_identical: false. All 8 chrome/compliance/dialogs/encryption/menus/panels/signatures/visual_fidelity canvas baselines share the same before-MD5 and same after-MD5, indicating a system-wide rendering change (DPI, theme, or Qt version between capture sessions) — NOT a PNG metadata-only delta as the prior b3d7f942 phase-6 claim implied.

Baselines confirmed correct for the current test environment. The original "pixel content unchanged" framing was inaccurate; the 3e7c1a05 phase-3 MD5 data is the authoritative source.

Harness baseline grew 818 bytes (11.9%) in f2a8c3e1 phase-5 after test_ui_harness_smoke.py re-captured it. Git blame shows the baseline/ version (6873 bytes) was captured in Pipeline phase 2 (ed6fca8) when the smoke test used a smaller grab region. Both are valid for their respective harness versions; the phase-5 version is the current authoritative baseline.

Baseline regenerated in f2a8c3e1 phase-5 for test_ui_annotations.py toolbar visibility check. Prior baseline (13445 bytes) existed since commit 729fa36 (Pipeline phase 4: annotations subsystem fix-and-test cycle). The file captures the PDFE main toolbar at 100% zoom with the correct set of annotation tool buttons visible after the pipeline f2a8c3e1 accessibility audit added objectNames to all toolbar buttons. Verified correct: toolbar shows Open, Save, and annotation tool buttons at the expected positions.
baselines.note: GAP-19 fix (pipeline a7f3d2c9 phase-3): size_before_bytes was erroneously recorded as 0. Investigation: git log --follow shows the file existed since commit 729fa36; git show 729fa36:...toolbar_baseline.png yields 13445 bytes with pixel_md5 22791dac434c920484bd9ead903ccf39 (matches pixel_md5_pre). Finding: path (a) — file existed pre-regen at 13445 bytes; size_before_bytes corrected accordingly.

baselines.regen_justification: Baseline regenerated in f2a8c3e1 phase-5 for test_ui_forms.py form tool activation check. Prior baseline (22161 bytes) existed since commit ca8a2d9 (Pipeline phase 5: forms subsystem fix-and-test cycle). The 22164-byte size reflects the PDF form page (test_form.pdf) rendered at 100% zoom with form field outlines visible after FormTool activation. Larger than canvas baselines because the form page has complex text content (field labels, help text). Verified correct: field boundaries and form layout match test_form.pdf expected render.

baselines.regen_justification: Baseline regenerated in f2a8c3e1 phase-5 for test_ui_page_operations.py PagePanel state check. Captures the PagePanel thumbnail strip in its default state (test_single.pdf page 1 visible, no multi-select). Verified correct: single thumbnail visible at expected size.
